newsitem.title: USA: Weirton, union extend labor agreement.
newsitem.headline: Weirton, union extend labor agreement.

text.p: Weirton Steel Corp said Monday it and the Independent Steelworkers Union have agreed to extend the expiration date of their labor agreement to December 15.
The current three-year agreement is scheduled to expire September 25, the company noted.

"This extension was necessitated by the timing of the steel industry wage reopener arbitration cases which are still in progress," explained David L. Robertson, Executive Vice President-Human Resources and Corporate Law.

"There is a mutual recognition by the parties that our efforts to fully understand and resolve significant challenges facing the Company and its employees, including the reline of the Company's No. 1 Blast Furnace scheduled to begin in the fourth quarter, would be facilitated by extending the current deadline," Robertson said.
